Job Description

This Opportunity
WSP USA hosts hundreds of interns across the United States to gain hands-on, meaningful work experience to enhance their education and professional aptitude. Our interns gain exposure to real projects while working side by side with senior staff. Through our Developing Professionals Network, interns gain mentorship, networking opportunities and lifelong career connections.
Our Planning Team is seeking a Transportation Data Analyst Intern to work out of our Seattle, WA office. This temporary position is seeking individuals currently enrolled in an Undergraduate or Graduate degree program.
This internship will be part of the WSP Summer Internship Program. As a summer intern, you have the opportunity to participate in our 12-week program scheduled to start on May 17th, 2027. The individual start date of the internship may be flexible.
Your Impact
Support a variety of transportation planning and data science tasks with the goal to develop technical, social, and ethical skills.
Learn basic principles of Planning and Data Science.
Assist with project research, field work, planning, and preliminary design calculations and analysis.
Support preparation of final design plans, documentations, special provisions, and cost estimates.
Assist in collecting and maintaining project documentation.
Complete training on assigned tasks.
Exercise responsible and ethical decision-making regarding company funds, resources and conduct, and adhere to WSP’s Code of Conduct and related policies and procedures.
Perform additional responsibilities as required by business needs.
Please note that there is no relocation or housing assistance associated with this internship.

Who You Are
Required Qualifications
Actively enrolled in an accredited Planning, Civil Engineering, Transportation Engineering, or related, Undergraduate program with an anticipated graduation date of August 2027 or later.
Demonstrated interest in planning, transportation, data science, or related field and have a strong desire to advance skills related to WSP’s work and projects.
Competent interpersonal and communication skills when interacting with others, expressing ideas effectively and professionally to an engineering and non-engineering audience.
Capable of taking direction from leadership, mentors, and managers to executive projects.
Basic proficiency with technical writing, office automation, software, spreadsheets, technology, and tools.
Proven track record of upholding workplace safety and ability to abide by WSP’s health, safety and drug/alcohol and harassment policies.
Authorization to work in the United States at the start of the internship

Preferred Qualifications
Actively enrolled in an accredited Planning, Civil Engineering, Transportation Engineering, or related, Masters or PhD program with an anticipated graduation date of August 2027 or later.
Experience using GIS, Python, R, GitHub, Microsoft Office Products.
Prior internship experience.

Compensation:
Expected Pay: $24.76 - $32.22 per hour
WSP USA is providing the compensation range that the company in good faith believes it might pay and offer for this position, based on the successful applicant’s education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities in addition to internal equity and specific geographic location. WSP USA reserves the right to ultimately pay more or less than the posted range and offer additional benefits and other compensation, depending on circumstances not related to an applicant’s sex or other status protected by local, state, and/or federal law.

About WSP
WSP USA is the U.S. operating company of WSP, one of the world's leading engineering and professional services firms. Dedicated to serving local communities, we are engineers, planners, technical experts, strategic advisors and construction management professionals. WSP USA designs lasting solutions in the buildings, transportation, energy, water and environment markets. With more than 15,000 employees in over 300 offices across the U.S., we partner with our clients to help communities prosper.

www.wsp.com

WSP provides a flexible and agile workplace model while meeting client needs. Employees are also afforded a comprehensive suite of benefits including medical, dental, vision, disability, life, and retirement savings focused on providing health and financial stability throughout the employee’s career.

At WSP, we want to give our employees the challenges they seek to grow their careers and knowledge base. Your daily contributions to your team will be essential in meeting client objectives, goals and challenges. Are you ready to get started?

WSP USA (and all of its U.S. companies) is an Equal Opportunity Employer Race/Age/Color/Religion/Sex/Sexual Orientation/Gender Identity/National Origin/Disability or Protected Veteran Status.

The selected candidate must be authorized to work in the United States.

## Company Description

**About the Opportunity**

We are seeking an experienced, hands-on **Senior Data Analyst** to help drive data-informed decision-making across our Consumer business. This role will partner closely with teams across Acquisition, Retention, Customer Care, Product, and PR to develop analytics solutions, improve data accessibility, and identify opportunities to optimize business performance.

The ideal candidate combines strong technical skills in Python and SQL with business acumen and the ability to translate complex data into actionable insights. You'll work with a variety of data sources, automation tools, and third-party integrations to build scalable reporting solutions, measure performance, and support marketing and product initiatives.

You'll also contribute to the development and enhancement of our industry-leading data resource providing insights into what Americans pay for their monthly household bills.

This is a highly collaborative, hands-on role offering the opportunity to make a meaningful impact across multiple areas of the business.

## Job Description

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

**Data Analytics & Business Insights**

* Partner with cross-functional teams to understand business needs, identify opportunities, and deliver actionable data insights.
    
* Develop and maintain dashboards, reports, and analytical tools to monitor key business and marketing performance metrics.
    
* Collaborate with Product teams to define KPIs and measure the effectiveness of new features, product releases, UX improvements, and A/B tests.
    
* Analyze customer behavior, acquisition, retention, and engagement trends to identify opportunities for growth and optimization.
    
* Support data-driven decision-making by making analytics and reporting more accessible to business stakeholders.
    

**Data Integration & Automation**

* Develop, maintain, and improve data pipelines, ETL processes, and integrations with third-party APIs.
    
* Work with Python- and SQL-based tools to support marketing automation, reporting, and data processing.
    
* Support data integrations with email marketing, paid advertising, and customer care platforms.
    
* Troubleshoot data quality issues and improve the reliability, accuracy, and efficiency of existing data processes.
    
* Identify opportunities to streamline workflows and automate recurring analytical tasks.
    

**Marketing & Product Analytics**

* Conduct analyses related to customer lifetime value (LTV), customer segmentation, campaign effectiveness, and conversion optimization.
    
* Support the design, execution, and evaluation of A/B tests and other experiments.
    
* Work with marketing stakeholders to measure campaign performance and identify opportunities to improve acquisition and retention.
    
* Contribute to the development, analysis, and ongoing improvement of doxoINSIGHTS data products and reporting.
    

## Qualifications

QUALIFICATIONS

**Required**

* 5+ years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, marketing analytics, or a related analytical role.
    
* Strong proficiency in SQL and Python, including experience working with complex datasets and automating data processes.
    
* Experience developing dashboards, reporting solutions, and data visualizations that support business decision-making.
    
* Working knowledge of ETL processes, data pipelines, and data integration concepts.
    
* Experience working with third-party APIs to retrieve, transform, or transmit data.
    
* Understanding of marketing and product analytics concepts, including customer segmentation, LTV, conversion funnels, and A/B testing.
    
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate data into clear, actionable recommendations.
    
* Excellent communication skills and the ability to collaborate with both technical and nontechnical stakeholders.
    
* Ability to independently manage analytical projects and prioritize competing business needs.
    

**Preferred**

* Experience with marketing automation platforms, paid advertising data, or customer engagement tools.
    
* Familiarity with statistical analysis, experimentation, and predictive modeling.
    
* Experience working in a consumer technology, SaaS, fintech, or other data-driven business.
    
* Experience with cloud-based data platforms and modern business intelligence tools.
    
* Bachelor's degree in Data Analytics, Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
    

## Additional Information

COMPENSATION

**Base Salary: $120,000-$140,000 annually**

At our client company, you'll have the opportunity to work with meaningful consumer and financial data, collaborate with teams across the business, and build analytical solutions that directly influence product and marketing decisions. This role offers a strong combination of technical challenges, business exposure, and individual ownership within a growing, data-driven organization.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Our client is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. They celebrate diversity and are dedicated to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

As a Program Data Analyst, you will be responsible for the following duties:

• Serves as a Program Analyst (Data Analytics) supporting leadership in coordinating the efforts of other agency professionals and contractors in solving complex and far reaching data management issues and problems for a wide range of systems, applications and customers.

• Conducts observational analyses using software and/or programming languages such as R, Python, or SAS to explore/group data, test hypotheses, predict outcomes, and inform decisions. Derives meaning from big data (i.e. datasets that may be large, disparate, unstructured, and/or complex), including structured, loosely structured, and unstructured data.

• Provides technical recommendations in the development and analysis of pilot initiatives and applications, and makes recommendations to management on the use of such technology as it relates to agency data.

• Contributes to internal and external process or system reviews, studies, projects, and data validation efforts, which provide a means for evaluating system performance and vulnerabilities.

• Serves as a resource to Federal and contractor staff on implementing, managing, tracking and evaluating large scale and extremely complex data analysis projects and their associated requirements and risks. Assists in defining customer requirements and applies system architecture principles to develop and manage technical requirements and achieve formulating, planning, stakeholder needs and constraints, clarifies objectives, develops resource requirements and the appropriate balance among resources, schedule and technical requirements.

DSA also founded and manages the Metropolitan Improvement District, a business-improvement area spanning 285 square blocks downtown. This role collects and analyzes a variety of economic, operational and public realm related data; develops dashboards, maps and recurring reports; assists in developing and implementing surveys to a variety of audiences, and communicates research findings to colleagues, DSA and MID leadership, MID ratepayers, DSA members, public partners and other key stakeholders. SENIOR DATA ANALYST — WORKFORCE PLANNING
CenterWell Pharmacy, a Humana company
ABOUT THE ROLE
Every prescription CenterWell Pharmacy fills depends on a chain of people being in the right place at the right time. The Workforce Planning team makes sure that capacity exists before the demand arrives. The team conducts long-term forecasts that impact hiring, mid-term capacity plans that shape staffing strategy, and short-term plans that hold service levels week to week.
If you have done demand planning or S&OP for a physical supply chain, this is the same discipline — our constrained resource is licensed, trained people instead of inventory.
We are building this function from the ground up. The architecture, the metrics, and the tooling are not decided yet, and we are hiring two Senior Data Analysts to help decide them.
WHAT YOU WILL DO
+ Turn messy, multi-source operational data into planning inputs the business can act on
+ Partner with operations, finance, and department leaders to understand what they actually need to decide
+ Build the tooling and data products that let planners and leaders answer their own questions
+ Bring rigor to how we measure ourselves — forecast accuracy, capacity use, cost per prescription, and the drivers underneath them

You have advanced Power BI skills (or Tableau/Looker and willingness to switch), have built KPI frameworks from scratch, and can decompose a metric to root cause rather than reporting variance.

+ Experience explaining a technical result to a non-technical audience
